import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

base = '04071f1767eedc17e9704be6551f59ac8ec04bff'
r1 = '3ef090f25949e49ecd241db45de6983d8d2feed4'
manifest = 'company_ui/certification/certification_manifest.json'

    'scripts/release_checks/run_final_visual_remediation_acceptance.py',
    'scripts/release_checks/run_stage_d_benchmark.py',
    'scripts/release_checks/waferfab_visual_contracts.py',
    'tests/test_visualizer_final_visual_remediation.py',
]
allowed = set(r1_files + [manifest])
status_lines = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], text=True).splitlines()
status_paths = {line[3:] for line in status_lines}
source_matches = {}
for path in r1_files:
    expected = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{r1}:{path}'])
    source_matches[path] = Path(path).read_bytes() == expected
collection = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '--collect-only'], text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
import re
match = re.search(r'(\\d+) tests collected', collection.stdout + collection.stderr)
manifest_diff = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--unified=0', '--', manifest], text=True)
print(json.dumps({
    'base': base,
    'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
    'base_is_ancestor': subprocess.run(['git', 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', base, 'HEAD']).returncode == 0,
    'status_paths': sorted(status_paths),
    'scope_exact': status_paths == allowed,
    'r1_source_bytes_match': all(source_matches.values()),
    'r1_source_match_details': source_matches,
    'live_collected_tests': int(match.group(1)) if match else None,
    'manifest_diff': manifest_diff,
}, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
if status_paths "'!= allowed or not all(source_matches.values()) or not match or int(match.group(1)) != 1108:
    raise SystemExit(1)
